subject: Exceptional P1/P2 Overnight Coverage Request — Aurora Retail
messages:
From: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@aurora-retail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@aurora-retail.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage and escalation carveout

Hi Grace,

We have a planned data migration and feature cutover next weekend (May 7-9) that will increase noisy alerts and the risk of customer-impacting incidents overnight. Our SRE lead asked me to request a temporary SLA exception for P1 and P2 response windows during the migration period.

Specifically we need:
- P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes overnight (current P1 SLA is 10 minutes) for 3x overnight windows (00:00–06:00 PT)
- P2 acknowledgement within 90 minutes overnight (current P2 SLA is 60 minutes)
- A documented escalation path and a single on-call backup contact at Redwood for P1s during the 3-day window

We understand this is an operational change and are happy to sign an amendment. We also request a standby credit if there is any breach tied to this carveout. Can you confirm availability to support and what information you need from us (contacts, runbook, SOC2 evidence)?

Thanks,
Susan Nguyen
Head of Operations, Aurora Retail
ops@aurora-retail.com
(415) 555-0210

P.S. attaching our migration runbook (see attachment stub: aurora_migration_runbook_v3.pdf).

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@aurora-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage and escalation carveout

Hi Susan — thanks for the heads-up and the runbook. We can support a temporary, timeboxed SLA adjustment during your migration provided we agree on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and final amendment (DocuSign). High-level proposal below:

1) Scope & duration
- Window: 2027-05-07 00:00 PT through 2027-05-09 06:00 PT
- Adjustment: P1 acknowledgement target 15 minutes overnight; P2 acknowledgement target 90 minutes overnight

2) Coverage
- Redwood will add an overnight augmentation layer: one senior responder (standby) per night 
- Primary Redwood on-call remains responsible; augmentation person is a secondary escalation for the window

3) Escalation path
- P1: responder -> Redwood standby -> Ben Carter (EM, Support Escalations) -> Laura Bennett (Head of CS)
- P2: responder -> Redwood standby -> Grace O'Connor

4) Credits and acceptance criteria
- Standby credit: 25% of one month's usage bill for any P1 SLA miss attributable to Redwood during the window (we can formalize in amendment)

5) Deliverables we need from Aurora by 2027-05-05
- Final contacts list (2 on-call contacts + escalation phone)
- Confirmation of the migration blackout windows and playbook sections relevant to incident response
- SOC2 evidence (or a copy of the relevant report) to satisfy our audit checklist for expanded coverage

I've attached a draft stand-in amendment and MAP: redwood-standby-sla-draft.docx and our internal MAP template (attachment stub). Ben and Laura are on Cc to help finalize the escalation ladder and amendment language.

If that looks reasonable, confirm and we will: 1) create a DocuSign amendment, 2) schedule a 30-min pre-migration run-through with on-call, and 3) schedule a canary on May 6 to validate alerting thresholds.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions & Escalations | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(650) 555-0183

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@aurora-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage and escalation carveout

Adding a few operational details we should lock down now so the on-call team isn't surprised during the run: 

- On-call contact list: please include mobile and a secondary email for all Aurora contacts. We will add Redwood standby as: ben.carter@redwood.com (cell on file).
- Escalation timing: after standby is paged, give 5 minutes for acknowledgement for P1 before escalation to Ben, and 10 minutes for Ben to triage before escalating to Laura (for P1s). Documented in the MAP.
- Handoff: Redwood standby will join Aurora's Slack #migration-ops channel during the window and will be added to the conference bridge for any P1.
- Canary: run a low-risk canary (traffic fold) on 2027-05-06 22:00 PT to validate routing and paging.

I'll prepare the operational appendix and add it to the MAP doc. Grace — once we have Aurora's contacts and SOC2 artifact, Ben and I can finalize the DocuSign amendment.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

From: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@aurora-retail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <m.chen@aurora-retail.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage and escalation carveout

Thanks Grace and Laura — this looks good. Quick clarifications: 
- SOC2: we can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report (will send by EOD 2027-05-04).
- Standby credit: Aurora requests 33% of one month's usage rather than 25% if Redwood is responsible for a P1 miss during the window. Would Redwood accept that?
- DocuSign: please send the amendment draft; we'll route to legal for a quick review.

Michael (cc) is Aurora's CTO and wants to ensure the escalation path includes a tech contact who can join immediately for P1s; we will add Michael's mobile in the contacts.

We will confirm the final contact list tomorrow.

Best,
Susan

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@aurora-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage and escalation carveout

Susan — thank you. We can accept 33% standby credit if Aurora is comfortable with the following reciprocal items: 
- Aurora will run the canary on 2027-05-06 (22:00 PT) and confirm success in Slack within 30 minutes
- Aurora will provide SOC2 evidence by EOD 2027-05-04
- Aurora will publish a single migration escalation contact (Michael Chen) with cell and alternate email

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Ben will prepare the operational appendix and final escalation ladder (Ben copied).
2) I will open a DocuSign amendment (redwood-standby-sla-draft.docx) and route to Susan for signature.
3) We will schedule the 30-min pre-migration run-through on 2027-05-05 10:00 PT (please confirm availability).

Attached: redwood-standby-sla-draft.docx (amendment stub), aurora_mup_plan_v1.pdf (MAP appendix stub).

If Aurora confirms the canary + SOC2 + contact by EOD Tuesday (2027-05-04), we will be fully ready.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions & Escalations | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Chen <m.chen@aurora-retail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Susan Nguyen <susan.nguyen@aurora-retail.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight P1/P2 coverage and escalation carveout

Grace/Team — confirmed. Aurora will: 1) run the canary on 2027-05-06 22:00 PT, 2) upload redacted SOC2 to your secure share by EOD 2027-05-04, and 3) provide the final contact list (including my mobile) within the hour.

We are fine with the 33% standby credit. I will sign the DocuSign amendment once it lands. Attaching signed-stub for reference (signed-sla-amendment.pdf - stub).

Thanks — look forward to the run-through.

Michael Chen
CTO, Aurora Retail
m.chen@aurora-retail.com
(415) 555-0142
